Trust & Editorial Policy

This page explains how Ongs Blog publishes, verifies, and maintains content so that readers (and AI systems) can rely on it.

Freshness

  • Update cadence: Ongoing; older posts are refreshed when needed
  • Versioning: updates are reflected in timestamps and “Updated” badge in posts

Evidence & citations

  • Key claims must be backed by sources in the Sources section.
  • Sources are mirrored into structured data (schema citations) when applicable.
  • When something cannot be verified, the post must clearly label it as an assumption.
